schedule.title: Idea Submission
schedule.description: Submit your Idea Document outlining your selected track, proposed solution, technology stack, team responsibilities, and execution plan.

schedule.title: Mid-Hackathon Review
schedule.description: Present your progress, demonstrate the working parts of your project, and receive feedback from the organizing team. This is a progress review, not an elimination round.

schedule.title: Final Submission Deadline
schedule.description: Submit your completed working project, deployment link, presentation slides, and all other required deliverables before the deadline.

schedule.title: NEXWIN Finals — Project Presentation
schedule.display: Saturday, 24 October 2026 · Timing to be announced
schedule.description: Present your final project to the reviewing team, explain your solution and technical decisions, and showcase your team's contributions. Presentation timings and further instructions will be announced by the organizers.

scheduleNote: Dates and timings are subject to change in the event of unforeseen circumstances. Any changes will be communicated through official NEXWIN announcements.
